title: Amazon Deal Recasts Upbound’s Rent A Center Stores As Traffic Hubs
title_zh: 亚马逊交易将 Upbound 的 Rent A 中心商店重塑为流量中心
summary: Upbound Group's Rent-A-Center unit has entered into a partnership with Amazon to provide nationwide in-store pickup and return services. The agreement allows thousands of Rent-A-Center locations to act as Amazon pickup and return points across the US.
summary_zh: Upbound Group 的 Rent-A-Center 部门已与亚马逊建立合作伙伴关系，提供全国范围内的店内提货和退货服务。该协议允许数千个 Rent-A-Center 地点作为亚马逊在美国各地的提货和还货点。

title: Alphabet stock climbs 2% on report of massive Anthropic deal
title_zh: Anthropic 大规模交易报道导致 Alphabet 股价上涨 2%
summary: Investing.com -- Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) rose 2% in after-hours trading Tuesday following a report that Anthropic has committed to spending approximately $200 billion with Google Cloud over the next five years.
summary_zh: Investing.com——Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL）周二盘后交易中上涨 2%，此前有报道称 Anthropic 承诺在未来五年内向 Google Cloud 投入约 2000 亿美元。

title: Alphabet Returns to Euro Debt Market for Latest AI Megabond Deal
title_zh: Alphabet 重返欧元债券市场进行最新人工智能超级债券交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Alphabet Inc. needs to borrow heavily to fund investments in artificial intelligence, and it’s increasingly tapping every market to do so.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Alphabet Inc. 需要大量借贷来资助人工智能投资，并且它正在越来越多地利用各个市场来实现这一目标。

title: Stock Market Today, May 4: ADT Falls as Apollo Exits Stake Through 102 Million-Share Offering
title_zh: 今日股市，5 月 4 日：Apollo 通过 1.02 亿股发行退出股份，ADT 下跌
summary: Apollo’s exit puts a large block of ADT shares into the market, while the company’s concurrent buyback absorbs only part of the selling pressure.
summary_zh: Apollo 的退出将大量 ADT 股票推向市场，而该公司同时进行的回购仅吸收了部分抛售压力。

title: Carlyle Expands Healthcare Push With Majority RCM Deal
title_zh: 凯雷通过 RCM 多数股权交易扩大医疗保健业务
summary: Carlyle acquired majority stakes in Knack RCM and EqualizeRCM to build a new revenue cycle management platform.
summary_zh: 凯雷收购了 Knack RCM 和 EqualizeRCM 的多数股权，以建立新的收入周期管理平台。
